Public Function Tried(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\ALPHA.XLSX", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    s = "saveas " & wb.Name & " dir " & Dir(folder & "\*.xlsx")
    wb.Save
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.SaveCopyAs folder & "\alpha.XLSX"
    s = s & "|copy dir " & Dir(folder & "\*.xlsx")
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\ALPHA.xlsx", 0)
    s = s & "|open " & wb.Name
    wb.Close False
    Tried = s
End Function
answer: saveas ALPHA.XLSX dir Alpha.xlsx|copy dir ALPHA.XLSX|open ALPHA.XLSX
